description_en: Modifies the minor version upgrade method for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL, ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, and ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS MySQL、PostgreSQL和SQL Server实例升级小版本的方式
name: ModifyDBInstanceAutoUpgradeMinorVersion

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The method used to upgrade the minor engine version of the instance. Valid values:
Auto: automatically upgrades the minor engine version.
Manual: does not automatically upgrade the minor engine version. The minor engine version is forcibly upgraded only when the current version is retired
parameters.help_zh:
实例升级小版本的方式，取值：
Auto：自动升级小版本。
Manual：不自动升级，仅在当前版本下线时才强制升级
parameters.name: auto_upgrade_minor_version
